walls.note: Plantage Middenlaan front, 12.57 m (facade ring edge 4), read from the rectified 2019 crop w01-209.alt.jpg (TMX7316010203-001181_pano_0000_003955, 50.2 px/m, heights h = (425 - y) / 50) and the 2023 frontal crop; the 2022 oblique (TMX7316010203-002541_pano_0000_003955 aimed view) shows the weatherboarding and the dormer set back behind the cornice with grey zinc cheeks.
Garden side (Artis), no panorama. Plain white shell with the hip roof; the 3DBAG 10.2 m strip at the north-west end is the taller neighbour bleeding into this pand and is not drawn.

The brief's wall is the back wing's north-west face (facade ring edge 1, a 1.9 m wide, 2.7 m high annexe behind the house); its 2022 crop sees the front obliquely past the tall brick neighbour Plantage Middenlaan 45, which covers the house's own north-west end entirely. Plain white shell.
